blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.10
blocks.problem: Calculate the molar concentration of a substance containing 27.64 g of K₂CO₃ dissolved in 1 dm³ of the given solution
steps: Molar mass of K₂CO₃ = 138.2 g mol⁻¹
Number of moles = Given mass / Molar mass
Molar Concentration = Number of moles / Volume in dm³
